schema_version.description: record schema version; absent on rows written before NOT-39 = legacy

session.description: primary conversation/session id for this check

session_ids.description: all known conversation/session ids for this stop

watched_writes.description: unsatisfied watched writes remain for this check (after Cursor after_ts filter)

wrote_watched.description: session had any watched-path writes (ignores after_ts); used for M3 success metric

declined.description: a lens_skip cleared the loop for this session (the owner deliberately held) — the loop's second exit

gate.description: what satisfied the gate: session = a lens_run; declined = a lens_skip; none = unsatisfied or no watched writes

excluded_writes.description: writes dropped by ~/.claude or system-temp exclusion

skip_reason.description: why enforcement did not block despite activity: declined (a lens_skip cleared it), enforce_false, no_watch_match, excluded_only

host.description: absent in records written before Cursor support = claude-code
